import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im20 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0020.png'))
# Stool legs in obs20
# Color of legs in obs20:
leg_crop = im20[340:400, 200:260]
# Find vertical grey legs
# Look for non-floor, non-wall pixels
# Floor is ~ (160, 155, 145)
# Leg color:
print('Sample leg pixel:', im20[380, 210], im20[380, 250])

mask = (np.abs(im20[:,:,0].astype(int) - 100) < 30) & (np.abs(im20[:,:,1].astype(int) - 110) < 30) & (np.abs(im20[:,:,2].astype(int) - 120) < 30)
coords = np.argwhere(mask)
# filter for u in [200, 260], v in [340, 400]
coords = [c for c in coords if 200 <= c[1] <= 260 and 340 <= c[0] <= 400]

print('Leg left bottom v:', leg_left[:,0].max(), 'u mean:', leg_left[leg_left[:,0] == leg_left[:,0].max(), 1].mean())
print('Leg right bottom v:', leg_right[:,0].max(), 'u mean:', leg_right[leg_right[:,0] == leg_right[:,0].max(), 1].mean())
